newsitem.title: USA: Xytronyx receives FDA approvable letter.
newsitem.headline: Xytronyx receives FDA approvable letter.

text.p: Xytronyx Inc on Friday said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has issued the company an approvable letter for its Periodontal Tissue Monitor, a test for periodontal disease that can be administered in a Dentist's office.
Full approval is contingent on manufacturing requirements and labeling, the company said in a statement.

Xytronyx has signed a letter of intent with Steri-Oss, a leading dental implant company, for the product's distribution in North America and other countries. It is currently being sold by Hawe-Neos Dental in Europe.
